verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents deployment tracking via API and CLI that records revisions and lets you correlate code changes with errors. When GitHub or GitLab is connected, each deploy revision links to a diff of what changed since the last deploy, and errors can be filtered with occurred.after:'last deploy'. Nothing shows per-issue release attribution or suspect-commit identification. Missing for 10: a per-issue 'first seen in release' display, suspect-commit attribution on each issue, and independent corroboration of release-to-error linking.
